![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Exposing component state to the global `window` object pollutes the global namespace and can lead to naming conflicts or security vulnerabilities. Use Vue Devtools for debugging component state instead.

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The `isCircle` ref is set to `true` upon detection but is never reset. This means it will remain `true` after the first circle is detected. It should be reset to `false` at the beginning of each check. Also, `reset()` is a relatively new API and may not be supported in all browsers. Using `clearRect()` is a more compatible alternative.

```
  isCircle.value = false
  if (canvasContext.value) {
    canvasContext.value.clearRect(0, 0, canvasContext.value.canvas.width, canvasContext.value.canvas.height)
  }
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The comment on line 82 mentions the "least squares method", but the algorithm implemented is a simpler statistical approach based on the standard deviation of radii from a mean center. Update the comment to accurately describe the implementation (e.g., "Use standard deviation of radii to check for circularity"). Also, the values `6` (on line 83) and `20` (on line 99) are magic numbers. Extract them into named constants at the top of the `<script>` section to improve readability and maintainability.
